name: Use of English
description: Exam-style use of English: open cloze texts, key word transformations, question tags, emphatic and inverted structures, linkers and register.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: I am not used ___ so early.
questions.explanation: Після «be used to» (звикнути до чогось) вживається герундій, тому — to getting up.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: Neither of the answers ___ correct.
questions.explanation: «Neither of» узгоджується з дієсловом в однині, тому is.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: She works in a bank, ___ she?
questions.explanation: Стверджувальне речення в Present Simple із «works» дає заперечний тег doesn't she.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: You have not met my brother, ___ you?
questions.explanation: Заперечне речення в Present Perfect дає стверджувальний тег have you.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: There is ___ sugar left in the jar.
questions.explanation: «Hardly any» означає «майже немає» і поєднується з незлічуваним sugar.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: It was so cold ___ we stayed indoors.
questions.explanation: Конструкція so + прикметник + that виражає наслідок, тому that.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: I would rather ___ at home this evening.
questions.explanation: Після «would rather» іде інфінітив без to — stay.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: He speaks English ___ well as his sister.
questions.explanation: Порівняння однакової міри будується як as … as, тому as well as.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: Let's go for a walk, ___?
questions.explanation: До спонукального речення з «Let's» додають тег shall we.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: I have been living here ___ five years.
questions.explanation: «For» вказує на тривалість дії — five years, а не момент її початку.

questions.title:
Read the text and choose the best option for the gap.

Volunteering has changed considerably over the past decade. It was once assumed that anyone offering their time had a whole afternoon to spare, and organisations built their programmes on that assumption. Today many charities report that their most reliable helpers are people who can give only an hour, but who give it every single week. Adapting to this has not been straightforward. Tasks have had to be broken into smaller units, and training has had to be shortened without becoming superficial. The charities that have managed the transition say the effort was worthwhile, because the pool of people willing to help turned out to be far larger than anyone had expected.

What was once assumed about people offering to volunteer?
options: That they had a long stretch of free time available.
That they wanted to be paid for their work.
That they would need very little training.
That they preferred to work at weekends.
questions.explanation: У тексті сказано, що раніше вважали: кожен волонтер має вільний цілий день.

options: People who give one hour but give it every week.

People who have retired from full-time work.
People who have completed a long training course.
questions.explanation: Найнадійнішими названо тих, хто дає лише годину, але щотижня.

questions.title:
Read the text and choose the best option for the gap.

Volunteering has changed considerably over the past decade. It was once assumed that anyone offering their time had a whole afternoon to spare, and organisations built their programmes on that assumption. Today many charities report that their most reliable helpers are people who can give only an hour, but who give it every single week. Adapting to this has not been straightforward. Tasks have had to be broken into smaller units, and training has had to be shortened without becoming superficial. The charities that have managed the transition say the effort was worthwhile, because the pool of people willing to help turned out to be far larger than anyone had expected.

Which change did charities have to make?
options: They divided the work into smaller tasks.
They reduced the number of volunteers accepted.
They stopped offering any training at all.
They moved most of their work online.
questions.explanation: Організації мусили поділити роботу на менші завдання.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the correct question tag.
questions.explanation: Тег повторює допоміжне дієслово з протилежним знаком: are → aren't you, never (заперечення) → does she, Let's → shall we, наказ → will you.

questions.title: Match each sentence half with the ending that completes it grammatically.
questions.explanation: Це усталені звороти: it is worth + -ing, it is time + минулий час, it is no use + -ing, it is likely + to-інфінітив.

questions.title: Match each quantifier with the sentence it fits.
pairs: There is plenty of room for everyone.
I need a couple of days to decide.
It took a great deal of effort.
A number of guests arrived early.
questions.explanation: Кожен квантифікатор має свою сполучуваність: plenty of room, a couple of days, a great deal of effort, a number of guests.

questions.title: Match each function with the structure that performs it.
questions.explanation: Функції закріплені за структурами: тег питає підтвердження, so + прикм. + that показує наслідок, would rather виражає перевагу, in order to — мету.

questions.title: Match each short response with the statement it answers.
pairs: I have never been to Spain.
questions.explanation: So do I погоджується зі стверджувальним реченням, Neither do I — із заперечним; допоміжне дієслово повторює те, що в оригіналі.

questions.title: Rewrite using the word given: They started the project three years ago. (BEEN)
options: The project has been running for three years.
The project has been ran for three years.
The project was been started three years ago.
The project has been started since three years.
questions.explanation: Із BEEN природна перебудова — Present Perfect Continuous: has been running for three years.

questions.title: Rewrite using the word given: It is a pity I did not book earlier. (WISH)
options: I wish I had booked earlier.
I wish I would book earlier.
I wish I have booked earlier.
questions.explanation: Жаль про минуле передається через wish + Past Perfect: I wish I had booked earlier.

questions.title: Rewrite using the word given: Somebody must repair the roof. (NEEDS)
questions.explanation: Після needs у значенні «потребує ремонту» вживається -ing форма: needs repairing.

questions.title: Rewrite using the word given: I did not go because I was ill. (HAVE)
options: I would have gone if I had not been ill.
I would go if I have not been ill.
I will have gone if I was not ill.
I had gone if I would not be ill.
questions.explanation: Нереальна умова в минулому: would have gone if I had not been ill.

questions.title: Rewrite using the word given: Nobody has seen him since Friday. (LAST)
options: The last time anybody saw him was on Friday.
The last time anybody has seen him is Friday.
Nobody has last seen him on Friday.
Friday was the last anybody sees him.
questions.explanation: Із LAST речення перебудовується як the last time anybody saw him was on Friday.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the tickets.
questions.explanation: Після «Not only» на початку речення потрібна інверсія — was he.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: It was in Odesa ___ they first met.
questions.explanation: Емфатична конструкція It was … that виділяє обставину місця.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: ___ he said made any difference to the outcome.
questions.explanation: Підмет «Nothing that he said» узгоджується з дієсловом в однині made.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: The more carefully you read, ___ you will make.
questions.explanation: Подвійний порівняльний the more … the fewer; mistakes — злічуваний іменник, тому fewer.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: Hardly anybody objected, ___ surprised the organisers.
questions.explanation: Which тут стосується всього попереднього речення, а не окремого іменника.

questions.title:
Read the text and choose the best option for the gap.

Learning an instrument as an adult is often described as a hopeless undertaking, and the evidence does not support that view. Adults do acquire fine motor control more slowly than children, and they rarely reach the fluency of someone who began at six. In almost every other respect, however, they have the advantage. They understand structure, they can analyse what went wrong in a difficult passage, and they practise deliberately rather than repeating a piece from beginning to end. Teachers who work with adult beginners report that the real obstacle is rarely ability. It is the expectation of rapid progress, which makes ordinary early difficulty feel like proof of failure.

What does the writer say about the common view of adult learners?
options: The evidence does not support it.
It is confirmed by recent research.
It applies only to string instruments.
It was first proposed by teachers.
questions.explanation: Автор пише, що дані не підтверджують поширеної думки про безнадійність.

questions.explanation: Дорослі повільніше набувають тонкої моторики.

By copying recordings note for note.
questions.explanation: Дорослі вправляються усвідомлено, а не програють твір від початку до кінця.

What do teachers identify as the real obstacle?

questions.explanation: Учителі називають головною перешкодою очікування швидкого поступу.

questions.title: Match each transformation cue with the structure it requires.
pairs: despite plus a noun or -ing form
such plus a noun phrase plus that
questions.explanation: DESPITE іде з іменником або -ing, ALTHOUGH — із підрядним реченням, SO — з прикметником, SUCH — з іменниковою групою.

questions.title: Match each emphatic structure with its plain equivalent.
pairs: What surprised us was the price.
Never have I seen such chaos.
I have never seen such chaos.
All I want is an explanation.
questions.explanation: Кожна емфатична структура має простий відповідник: it-cleft виділяє діяча, what-cleft — підмет, інверсія після never підсилює заперечення.

questions.title: Match each formal linker with the relationship it expresses.
questions.explanation: Формальні сполучники різняться значенням: nevertheless — поступка, consequently — наслідок, furthermore — додавання, conversely — протиставлення.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the error it contains.
pairs: Despite of the rain, we walked.
a clause linker used with a noun
We walked, in spite the rain.
questions.explanation: Помилки типові: despite of — зайвий прийменник, although з іменником — сполучник не на своєму місці.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: Under no circumstances ___ the equipment be left unattended.
questions.explanation: Після «Under no circumstances» на початку речення потрібна інверсія — should the equipment be left.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: So rapid ___ the decline that the shop closed within a year.
questions.explanation: Інверсія після винесеного вперед «So rapid» дає was the decline.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: ___ for the delay, the delegation would have arrived on time.
questions.explanation: Зворот «But for the delay» означає «якби не затримка».

questions.title: Rewrite using the word given: People believe he left the country. (THOUGHT)
options: He is thought to have left the country.
He is thought to leave the country then.
He thought to have left the country.
It is thought him to have left the country.
questions.explanation: Із THOUGHT будується складний підмет: He is thought to have left the country.

questions.title: Complete the sentence: The proposal, ___ merits are undeniable, remains unfunded.
questions.explanation: Присвійний відносний займенник whose приєднує «merits» до «the proposal».

questions.title: Complete the sentence: Such ___ the confusion that the meeting was abandoned.
questions.explanation: Після винесеного вперед «Such» іде інверсія: Such was the confusion.

questions.title: Match each inverted structure with the meaning it emphasises.
pairs: Only after the audit did they act.
Rarely has a decision been so criticised.
Not until dawn did the storm ease.
Had they consulted us, this could have been avoided.
questions.explanation: Інверсія підкреслює саме винесений уперед елемент: only after — затримку, rarely — незвичність.

questions.title: Match each nominalisation with the plain verb phrase it replaces.
questions.explanation: Номіналізація згортає дієслівну фразу в іменникову: the implementation of → putting into practice.

questions.title: Match each hedging expression with the caution it signals.
pairs: an impression rather than a fact
it is by no means clear
questions.explanation: Хеджування пом'якшує твердження: suggest — обережне читання даних, it appears — враження, some indication — натяк.
